project.title: Ken Arok: Takdir dari Tumapel — Prototype 30s — I2V Google Flow
project.style: cinematic realistic, Javanese period drama, dark-fantasy tones

instructions_for_agent.purpose: Batch I2V generation via Google Flow Veo — 6 segmen × 4s = 24s total

platform_constraints.notes: Resolusi rendah (360p) tidak masalah — bisa di-upscale di akhir via ffmpeg/Real-ESRGAN

instructions_for_agent.execution_strategy: Manual upload one-by-one di Google Flow web UI (tidak ada batch API)

phases.name: Generate Video Clips via Google Flow Veo

jobs.motion_prompt: Camera tracks rapidly backward ahead of Ken Arok, keeping him centered as foliage whips past frame edges
jobs.motion_camera: rapid backward tracking, ahead of subject

audio_context.bgm: tense tribal percussion building, fast tempo matching footstep rhythm
audio_context.sfx: heavy panting, twigs snapping, distant shouting soldiers, metallic armor rattle

jobs.motion_prompt: Low-angle medium shot pans slightly up as Ken Arok lands on log, emphasizing agile stance and height advantage over pursuers
jobs.motion_camera: low-angle medium, slight pan up as subject lands

audio_context.tts_text: Hanya segitu kecepatan prajurit istana? Kura-kura di rawa pun masih bisa mendahului kalian!
audio_context.sfx: subject's confident exhale, soldiers' guttural grunts

jobs.segment_notes: Pivot moment — sage halts conflict, shifts tone
jobs.motion_prompt: Slow tilt-up from hem of Lohgawe's robes revealing his serene face and raised hand, establishing dominant spiritual presence
jobs.motion_camera: slow stately tilt up from hem of robes to serene face and raised hand

audio_context.tts_text: Hentikan amarah kalian. Darah anak muda ini bukan untuk tumpah di tanah berlumpur ini.
audio_context.bgm: ambient drone fades in, percussion silences
audio_context.sfx: wind hushes through leaves, soldiers' footsteps stop

jobs.segment_notes: The prophecy moment — turning point of Ken Arok's life
jobs.motion_prompt: Slow tense two-shot arc gently rotates around the two men, ending framed over Lohgawe's shoulder onto Ken Arok's stunned reaction
jobs.motion_camera: slow tense two-shot arc, rotates around the two men

audio_context.tts_text: Aku tidak menaruh kasihan, Ken Arok. Aku menaruh ramalan. Dewa Wisnu tidak mengirimmu ke dunia fana hanya untuk menjadi pencuri rendahan.
audio_context.bgm: low ethereal drone swells, all other ambient cut
audio_context.sfx: subject's breath catches, heartbeat subtly thumps

jobs.motion_prompt: Rapid snap zoom punch-in directly into Ken Arok's pupils, freezing momentarily before settling with subtle trembling handheld framing
jobs.motion_camera: rapid snap zoom punch-in to pupils, freeze, then subtle handheld tremble

audio_context.bgm: heartbeat thump loud, sub-bass pulse, ethereal chime
audio_context.sfx: muffled heartbeat, subtle whoosh mirroring thunderous shock

jobs.motion_prompt: Slow pull-back shot rising higher, re-establishing wide composition as Ken Arok walks away into god rays, title fades in
jobs.motion_camera: slow pull-back rising higher, crane up revealing sun

audio_context.bgm: swelling orchestral strings + gamelan motif, dramatic resolution
audio_context.sfx: wind through canopy, distant bird call
